description: This file defines the TimesheetColumn class in the OrangeHRM Time module. It encapsulates information related to a specific timesheet column, primarily storing a date and a total value, with methods to retrieve and increment the total.

classes.name: TimesheetColumn
classes.description: A Data Transfer Object representing a timesheet column with a specific date and aggregate total.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a TimesheetColumn with a specific DateTime.

methods.name: getDate
methods.description: Returns the date associated with this timesheet column.

methods.name: getTotal
methods.description: Returns the total amount associated with this timesheet column.

methods.name: incrementTotal
methods.description: Increments the total by a specified amount and returns the new total.
